Fire spreads fastest uphill, so the crew is safe only on a route that stays below the elevation of F the whole way. 4 escape trails (dashed black lines) leave S: Alder Trail, Flume Trail, Birch Trail and Ridge Trail. Exactly one of them never climbs to the elevation of F. Which trail should the crew take? Answer with the trail name, for example Alder Trail.

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

message.content:
